clips.name: impact_metal
clips.prompt: Heavy metal-on-metal collision impact, deep bass thud with a sharp metallic clang and a short ringing decay, dry, close perspective.

clips.name: station_hum
clips.prompt: Space station interior ambience, low steady mechanical drone with a subtle electrical buzz and distant air-handling, smooth and continuous, spacious.

clips.name: thruster_loop
clips.prompt: Powerful spaceship rocket engine sustained burn, deep resonant low-frequency roar and thick warm sub-bass rumble, smooth full-bodied drone, steady and continuous, no hiss, no transients, no static.

clips.name: ui_click
clips.prompt: Soft futuristic user-interface button click, a single short crisp digital tick with a subtle synthetic resonance, clean and dry, very close perspective.
